message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts. Facts: employer Chen owes wages to workers, refused to pay, escaped, later partially paid. This is typical crime of "拒不支付劳动报酬" (refusal to pay labor remuneration). In Chinese criminal law, article 275? Actually "拒不支付劳动报酬罪". So charge: 拒不支付劳动报酬.

Any other charges? Possibly "逃匿" but not a separate crime. The fact that he issued IOU (欠条) after partial payment. No other crimes like fraud, illegal occupation, etc. So single charge.

Thus answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>
